title: RevivalRpMods
description: A Minecraft 1.21.8 modpack for roleplay servers. Adds new biomes, dungeons, RPG skill trees, building blocks, and tech mods for survival and adventure.
body:
# 🌟 Minecraft Modded Server

## 🌿 World Generation & Biomes

| Mod | Adds | Download |
|-----|------|----------|
| **Biomes O’ Plenty** | 50+ new biomes with trees, plants, and improved world generation | [Download](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/biomes-o-plenty) |
| **Serene Seasons** | Seasonal changes affecting weather, crops, and the environment | [Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/sereneseasons) |
| **TerraBlender** | Smooth biome transitions and improved terrain generation | [Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrablender) |

---

## ⚔️ Dungeons, Quests & Exploration

| Mod | Adds | Download |
|-----|------|----------|
| **Dungeons & Taverns** | New dungeons, taverns, towns, and loot-rich exploration | [Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns) |
| **Dungeons & Taverns: Ocean Monument Overhaul** | Redesigned ocean monuments for underwater challenges | [Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns-ocean-monument-overhaul) |
| **Deimos** | New dangerous mobs and combat challenges | [Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/deimos) |
| **Daily Quests** | Daily missions with rewards for progression | [Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/daily-quests) |
| **Default Skill Trees** | RPG-style skill trees for character progression | [Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/default-skill-trees) |
| **Puffish Attributes / Skills** | Additional skill and attribute system for RPG progression | [Download Attributes](https://modrinth.com/mod/puffish-attributes) |

| **Diagonal Fences / Walls / Windows** | Decorative block variants for advanced building | [Download Fences](https://modrinth.com/mod/diagonalfences) |

| **Clumps** | Merges item drops for easier collection and performance | [Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/clumps) |
